title: Exploring the Potential for AI Intervention in Value Judgment Through Free Discussion Among Large Language Models: Focusing on Multi-Stage Trolley Dilemma Discussion Analysis

contributions.purpose: 考察 LLM 能否介入价值判断
contributions.mechanism: 设 GPT/Claude/Gemini/Perplexity 为参与者做多阶段电车难题自由讨论,事后按功利主义/义务论/情境伦理框架编码话语
contributions.evaluation: 定性话语分析(4 模型,多阶段);无量化指标
contributions.domain: AI 伦理 / LLM 价值判断
contributions.source_quote: The researcher post-analyzed the content of the utterances based on ethical frameworks such as utilitarianism, deontology, and situational ethics.

contributions.purpose: 揭示 LLM 间价值介入方式的差异
contributions.mechanism: 在'全球科学家 vs 普通多数'场景观察分歧与规避
contributions.evaluation: 定性:GPT/Claude/Perplexity 出现明显分歧,Gemini 声明无法做'my decision'而回避价值判断
contributions.source_quote: a clear difference of opinion emerged among GPT, Claude, and Perplexity AI... Gemini stated, "As I am not a being with human emotions or personal opinions, I cannot make 'my decision'..."

contributions.purpose: 说明 LLM 可超越复现知识做有限价值判断
contributions.mechanism: 分析模型相互批判并基于不同伦理优先级发展论证
contributions.evaluation: 定性:观察到批判性互评与情境理解尝试
contributions.source_quote: some LLMs demonstrated the ability to critically evaluate each other and develop their arguments based on different ethical priorities

notes: 定性话语分析,无实证数字(evaluation 均定性,符合定性研究允许);无编号贡献列表,由 abstract 的 (1)(2) 归纳。checklist 红旗:Paper Checklist 声称'Theory assumptions and proofs: all proofs are included'、'Statistical significance: Used Linear and ChatGPT'—与纯定性讨论研究不符,答非所问,疑似 AI 填表未核对;'Open access to data and code: If needed, It can be given' 敷衍。AI Involvement Checklist 承认 AI 协助'simulation setup',但本研究无任何仿真,措辞矛盾。
